findings.detail: The host-native serving path (OVMS systemd/podman service + model-pull graph max_length=4096, i915.reset=1) is defined by NixOS modules in the separate nixos-k3s-configs repo and is not present in this workspace checkout (live-verify.md confirms the module source is not grep-able in the local dev branch, i.e. deployed to /nix/store but its source lives on another branch/host-local config). The in-cluster side (proxy Deployment+ConfigMap, scaled-to-0 StatefulSet) IS captured here. This is an inherent cross-repo boundary already flagged for the user and cannot be committed from this workspace. Non-blocking: ensure the fleet's NixOS deployment branch has the ovms-embeddings-host module committed+pushed so the full topology is reproducible end to end.
